name: East on Division @ The Firehouse BBQ and Blues in Dunkirk, IN | Sat, Oct 3 | 6:00pm - 9:00pm
description:
East on Division will be playing live music at The Firehouse BBQ and Blues in Dunkirk, Indiana on Saturday, October 3 from 6:00 until 9:00pm.

This is an ALL AGES SHOW! Come enjoy the nice weather outside with some delicious BBQ, cold drinks, and toe-tapping blues and classic rock.
